terms.gloss: a measure, a measurement: a metric
evidence: Lewis & Short: “a measuring, measure”; “a measure, by which any thing is measured”
terms.comment: The classical word for a measure, and so for what is measured and tracked. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a metric in this sense.
Plural numerī: the figures, when one is thinking of the reported statistics.

phrases.english: I need to check the figures.

sources: Lewis & Short: numerus · Lewis & Short: mensura
